questions.question: Four letter-clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the letter-cluster that is different.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a08c777a36f898d492c29ef3a13c1a9aad5b988568e613e5a9282d9466dd8871.png] 

The logic followed here is:

 
• **OQP → O + 2 = Q; Q - 1 = P**
 
• UYW → U + 4 = Y; Y - 2 = W
 
• DHF → D + 4 = H; H - 2 = F
 
• LPN → L + 4 = P; P - 2 = N

Hence, '**OQP**' is the odd one out.

questions.question:
There are 9 members, C, D, E, F, G, H, I, J and K, in a joint family. There are three married couples in the family. D is a teacher and the brother of E and F. G is the mother of I. J is the wife of C, and C is the grandfather of I. E is the only daughter of C. K is the daughter of F and H.

Who is the wife of the teacher?
questions.solution:
There are 9 members, **C, D, E, F, G, H, I, J and K**, in a joint family. There are three married couples in the family.

 
• D is a teacher and the brother of E and F.
 
• G is the mother of I.
 
• J is the wife of C, and C is the grandfather of I.
 
• E is the only daughter of C.
 
• K is the daughter of F and H.

By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e70b8fc59f55523cbd1c0dcb6157cdd0120d14d1918de4106bf11139640dba2e.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e71551bc8def2c20e8adc9084f18ee507500753180604ce8517f15270907db5.png] 

D is the teacher and his wife is G.

Hence, ‘**G**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: 'Triangle’ is related to ‘Pyramid’ in the same way as ‘Rectangle’ is related to ‘________’.
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• 'Triangle’ is related to ‘Pyramid’ → A pyramid is a structure whose outer surfaces are triangular.

Similarly,

 
• ‘Rectangle’ is related to ‘________’ → Cuboid is a hexahedron, a six-faced solid whose outer surfaces are rectangle.

Hence, '**Cuboid**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the fourth number in the same way as the first number is related to the second number.

36 : 9 :: ? : 16
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• 36 : 9 → 36 ÷ 4 = 9

Similarly,

 
• ? : 16 → ? ÷ 4 = 16
 
• ⇒ ? = 16 × 4
 
• ⇒ ? = 64

Hence, '**64**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Pranavi, Vinita, Rupa, Soumya, Bhavana, Urmila and Arohi are seven friends sitting in a circle, facing the centre of the circle. Arohi is second to the left of Soumya and is the neighbour of Bhavana and Urmila. Soumya is not a neighbour of Rupa or Bhavana. Pranavi is a neighbour of Vinita and Rupa.

Based on the given information, which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: Arohi is sitting between Rupa and Pranavi.
Rupa is sitting between Bhavana and Pranavi.
Vinita is sitting between Bhavana and Pranavi.
Soumya is sitting between Urmila and Arohi.

questions.solution:
**Pranavi, Vinita, Rupa, Soumya, Bhavana, Urmila and Arohi** are seven friends sitting in a circle, facing the centre of the circle.

1. Arohi is second to the left of Soumya and is the neighbour of Bhavana and Urmila.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3358d9c1e4691a2043790612584de1834f29e8c3b48af8fa124f45b544a29f51.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b63540b6f1a6588c0cae902a7d6e1bbd6401d9f9dbc70323862c81b7096b86b8.png] 

2. Soumya is not a neighbour of Rupa or Bhavana.

Case II is eliminated based on the above statement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11b76b3fdc7278ee1dd438cb0d01b8cc096a57aa82225b45d8bb75450b4ffb1e.png] 

3. Pranavi is a neighbour of Vinita and Rupa.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d18ab1fde57c46c76792a673895460adcff71d3fd7f40af77be14a0381f8e3f.png] 

Based on the given information, the statement which is correct is: 

 
• Arohi is sitting between Rupa and Pranavi. → False
 
• Rupa is sitting between Bhavana and Pranavi. → True
 
• Vinita is sitting between Bhavana and Pranavi. → False
 
• Soumya is sitting between Urmila and Arohi. → False

Hence, '**Rupa is sitting between Bhavana and Pranavi**' is the correct answer.

questions.question: Sarayu bought two refrigerators at two different prices, for a total cost of ₹80,000. By selling one for 3/4 of its cost price and another for 4/3 of its cost price, she earns a profit of ₹8,000 on the whole transaction. Find the cost price of the refrigerator which was bought at a higher price.
questions.solution:
**Given: **

The total cost price of two different refrigerators is 80,000.

The selling price of two different refrigerators is 88,000.

**Let,**

the cost price of two different refrigerators is x and y respectively.

So, x + y = 80,000 ---------------(i)

By selling one for 3/4 of its cost price and another for 4/3 of its cost price, she earns a profit of ₹8,000.

So, The selling price of two different refrigerators is 88,000. 

Therefore,

(3/4)x + (4/3)y = 88,000 

⇒ (9x + 16y)/ 12 = 88,000

⇒ 9x + 16y = 1056000 ----------------(ii)

From, (i) and (ii) 

(9x + 16y) - (9x + 9y) = 1056000 - 720000

⇒ 9x + 16y - 9x - 9y = 336000

⇒ 7y = 336000

⇒ y = 48000

Then x = 80000 - 48000 = 32000

Hence, the cost price of the refrigerator which was bought at a higher price is 48000 rs.

Hence, the correct answer is **"option (3)".**

 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0b10b6038e2e40903967ad8aafa96dc54c4f78cc279979ab26507dd41dc511b.png] **

** 3 : 2**

5X = 80000

X = 16000

**Hence, X = 48000.**

Who among the following sits third to the left of J?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c4f73444ff5a17f7a425408e7db017726d572342f5f2c798f2f04afd28f9d078.png]
